function: Joint learned decision of whether to estimate the cascaded channel in each slot and of the IRS passive phase-shift vector, maximizing cumulative throughput (p. 3).
system: Single-antenna BS and UE, passive reflecting IRS with N=20-128 elements (64 in Fig. 5), blocked direct link, 2 GHz, flat fading (pp. 3, 10-12).
method: Bilevel POMDP solved by model-free deep reinforcement learning: PPO actor-critic with RNN/GRU or variational belief networks; offline training, online execution (pp. 5-10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: cascaded BS-IRS-UE channel, log-distance path loss (exponent 2.8), first-order Gauss-Markov fading with correlation rho 0.9-0.999; same model for training and testing, no dataset (pp. 3, 10-11).
test_conditions: Same channel model for training and testing at each fixed rho, N, delta; 10000 epochs of 1000 slots; retraining if channel model or N changes (pp. 10-11).
baselines: Periodic-GD (non-learned: least-squares CE, gradient-descent phases); Periodic-PPO (K=1, K*), the proposed framework without sensing module; RNN-based PPO, itself proposed (p. 10).
metrics: Average data rate (bits/s/Hz), average CE interval, NMSE of the belief mean against the true CSI, epochs to converge (pp. 11-12).
complexity: O(.) training complexity of Algorithm 1 in terms of layer weights (RNN, policy, FC layers); none for Belief-based PPO, no FLOPs or runtime (pp. 6-7).
q1_support: p. 3: "The Gauss-Markov model has been widely applied in the existing works". Custom Gauss-Markov fading with log-distance path loss (p. 10); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "the policy network should be re-trained if the channel model changes or the number of IRS elements varies". Each rho and N is trained separately (p. 11); nothing is tested outside its training condition.
q3_support: p. 10: "remove the sensing module from Fig. 1 since the CE decisions are deterministic". Periodic-PPO is an ablation of the proposed method; Periodic-GD is non-learned; no earlier learned IRS method is compared.
q4_support: p. 7: "computational complexity of our proposed algorithm". Training complexity of Algorithm 1 is given as an O(.) expression over layer weights (pp. 6-7).
q5_support: p. 11: "evolved to new channel realizations in the subsequent time slots according to the channel model given in (6)". Data come from the authors' own simulator; no code or data link appears.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Area 3 because the main metric is the data rate of the jointly learned CE decision and IRS phase shifts; the belief-based CSI inference is scored by NMSE only in Fig. 6 (p. 11). Passes the system check only through the IRS, since BS and UE have one antenna (p. 3). q3 is 0: Periodic-PPO removes the sensing module (ablation), RNN-based and Belief-based PPO are both proposed, Periodic-GD is non-learned; an RNN-based DQN is named on p. 10 but is neither defined nor shown in any figure. q4 counts the O(.) training complexity of Algorithm 1 only (p. 7). Reviewer to confirm q3 and q4.
